author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಧೃತಿದಮಾದಿಗಳನು ಬರಿಗಣ್ಣು ಕಾಣದವು
ಕೃತಿಗಳಲಡಗಿರುವ ಧರ್ಮವನೆ ಕಾಣು
ಮೃತಿಯೆಂದು ಉಳಿಯುವನು ಕಾಯಕದ ಬೆಂಬಲದಿ
ಶೃತಿ ತಿರುಳರಿತು ನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Fortitude, self-control and the rest cannot be seen with the naked eye;
see the dharma hidden inside deeds;
a person lives beyond death through the support of his work;
know the essence of the Veda and walk by it, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Virtues such as fortitude (dhṛti) and self-control (dama), listed in the classic marks of dharma, are invisible; they show only in action. Our work outlives us. Grasp the heart of scripture and live by it.
